countingRule.statement: A Houston MSA Z1 SEARCHED-AND-ABSENT row is NO-SIGNAL iff its agol-search probe recorded hits:0. Municipal-root services:[] does NOT count as signal (ZCHAL: synthetic hostname path returned empty for 104/104 non-Houston absences; a no-op cannot evidence absence). Rows with agol-search hits>0, a doctrine short-circuit, or a later positive determination (layer recovered, host advertised-but-broken, ordinance publisher verified) are SIGNAL and are not in the no-signal downgrade set.
